statement.p: If possible, choose k so that the following function is continuous on any interval: f(x)= \begin{cases} \frac{3x^{5}-6x^{4}}{x-2}\quad \amp x \ne 2 \\ k \amp x = 2. \end{cases}

p.em: (If no k will make the function continuous, enter none)

static.solution:
k, the function is continuous on any interval that does not contain x=2.
Since 3 x^{5} - 6 x^{4} = 3 x^{4}(x - 2), we can cancel (x-2) provided x\ne 2, giving
f(x) = \frac{3x^{5}-6x^{4}}{x-2} = 3 x^{4},\quad\quad x\ne 2. Thus, if we pick k = 3 (2)^{4} = 48, the function is continuous.
